-- REQ: LANG-1721 LANG-1722
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION greet(p_name TEXT, p_times INT DEFAULT 1)
RETURNS TEXT AS $$
DECLARE
  v_text TEXT := 'Hello, ' || p_name || '!';
  i INT;
BEGIN
  FOR i IN 1..p_times LOOP
    RAISE NOTICE '% (%)', v_text, i;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_text;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN others THEN RETURN NULL;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
